==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "NUMBER" with the appropriate issue number.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>FactFile2014Release|''NUMBER''}}

===Example===
 <nowiki>{{FactFile2014Release|75}}</nowiki>
*{{FactFile2014Release|75}}
